headline: Insurance renewals, elevator maintenance contract, and MRVP voucher rent standards among items for discussion.
summary: The meeting will cover insurance renewals, an elevator maintenance contract, and MRVP voucher-related rent and payment standards. It will also address proposed policy changes and a contract amendment, followed by an executive session on real estate.
items: Massachusetts Rental Voucher Program (MRVP) Project-Based Vouchers (PBV) Maximum Allowable Contract Rents
Proposed Changes to the Admin Plan – Rental Increases
Proposed Changes to the Federal Public Housing Reasonable Accommodation Policy
LHA Contract for Financial Assistance 5010 - Amendment No. 3
Executive Session: Discussion on real estate
